function.name: patient_risk_score
function.description: Calculates the risk score (0-100) for a patient based on age, number of conditions, average condition severity, and abnormal vitals in recent records (last 90 days). Returns 0.0 if patient not found.

hospital.description: The hospital object containing patient data and record access.

patient_id.description: The unique ID of the patient whose risk score should be calculated.
